title: KAD-PI Ideal State V2 Specification & Traceability Architecture

requirements.statement: KAD-PI MUST function primarily as a local-first Personal Engineering Operating System and Scientific Research Laboratory, prioritizing human cognitive leverage, formal systems engineering, scientific repeatability, and practical personal maintainability over multi-tenant SaaS or autonomous factory topologies.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_01 mandates personal engineering OS and research laboratory as non-negotiable core.
requirements.verification_strategy: Architectural inspection and doctor validation confirming all execution and knowledge subsystems subordinate to personal engineering workflows.

requirements.statement: The system MUST be optimized exclusively for the sole project lead (AMDY), with portable and reproducible architecture allowing trusted collaborators (2-5 peers) to inspect or replicate isolated components without turning KAD into an enterprise multi-user suite.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_02 excludes multi-tenancy, enterprise RBAC, and general public user onboarding overhead.
requirements.verification_strategy: Audit of workspace permissions, credential paths, and single-operator workflow constraints.

requirements.statement: KAD-PI MUST maintain a private core repository for personal engineering and publish open research, specifications, benchmarks, and standalone tools only through governed, staged extraction.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_21 adopts staged hybrid: private personal OS + open extractable research artifacts.
requirements.verification_strategy: Publication filter verification ensuring private vault notes and unvetted credentials cannot leak into public releases.

requirements.statement: The project lead MUST retain sole sovereign authority as Strategic Governor and Research Director over charter, scope, risk tolerance, financial expenditure, canonical knowledge doctrine, and policy changes, while delegating bounded routine implementation and validation to agents under policy-bounded execution.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_03 defines human position as strategic governor rather than manual line-coder or passive spectator.
requirements.verification_strategy: Policy validation ensuring all mutating transitions to canonical knowledge, policy, and budget require human signature/lease.

requirements.statement: The system MUST treat loss of human cognitive leverage, degradation of epistemic trust, unvetted provider lock-in, or increasing human cognitive fatigue as a definitive architectural failure condition regardless of raw token throughput.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_04 sets cognitive leverage and epistemic integrity as the ultimate optimization metric.
requirements.verification_strategy: Human intervention telemetry and contradiction audit ensuring system complexity does not escalate human maintenance burden.

requirements.statement: Agents MUST operate under a Tier-Tiered Bounded Autonomy model where research, planning, localized code edits, and test generation are autonomous within an active STC workctl lease, while main branch merges, external network access, and policy mutations require explicit human or policy approval.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_05 prohibits both unrestricted agent execution and micromanaged step-by-step human typing.
requirements.verification_strategy: STC lease boundaries and workctl lease validation tests (e.g. stc-lease.test.mjs).

requirements.statement: Models and agents MUST propose knowledge changes only; canonical knowledge promotion into the KnowledgePlane Vault MUST be authorized exclusively by human review or deterministic evidence gates.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_06 establishes Human Epistemic Sovereignty with Policy-Bounded Promotion.
requirements.verification_strategy: Librarian and wiki linter tests verifying models cannot write directly to canonical doctrine zones without gate pass.

requirements.statement: KAD-PI MUST embed a lean, high-leverage, deterministic Project Management Kernel within workctl that natively manages WBS/DAG dependency graphs, STC lease claims, quality gates, and decision/risk registers, while deliberately rejecting bureaucratic enterprise agile frameworks.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_17 focuses PM tooling strictly on functions governing authority, sequencing, and quality.
requirements.verification_strategy: workctl ticket and DAG validation suites verifying dependency tracking and critical path calculations.

requirements.statement: Workpackages MUST be hierarchically decomposed with explicit acceptance contracts, where strategic goals are set by the human, typed WBS packages are proposed by planning roles, and execution leases are validated against DAG dependencies before dispatch.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_18 mandates hierarchical evidence-governed decomposition over freeform agent swarms.
requirements.verification_strategy: Workpackage schema validation and workctl claim verification tests.

requirements.statement: The system MUST enforce strict verification independence under the constitutional invariant: MUTATOR != SOLE VERIFIER != ACCEPTANCE AUTHORITY. Implementing agents cannot self-certify significant architectural or code mutations.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_19 rejects agent self-certification as a critical quality vulnerability.
requirements.verification_strategy: Role contract and workctl transition checks verifying that review and acceptance require distinct agents or deterministic test suites.

requirements.statement: KAD-PI MUST execute external scientific research through a strict tiered epistemic pipeline: Question -> Source Extraction -> Provenance Validation -> Claim Triangulation -> Empirical Verification -> Advisor Review -> Human Promotion.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_13 prevents hallucinated claims and unverified web search summaries from polluting canonical doctrine.
requirements.verification_strategy: Research workflow tests (tools/kad/test/research*.test.mjs) verifying provenance capture and claim classification.

requirements.statement: The KnowledgePlane MUST maintain sovereign epistemic authority across typed representations (Canonical Doctrine, Authoritative Evidence Records, Derived Projections, Candidate, Contested, and Historical states); the Obsidian Vault serves as the primary human-readable, git-diffable, portable offline doctrine surface, while structured records/receipts serve as authoritative evidence without storage format alone conferring authority.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_14 establishes KnowledgePlane sovereign authority across multiple typed representations without storage format dogma.
requirements.verification_strategy: Vault projection rebuild tests verifying complete state can be reconstructed from Markdown files alone.

requirements.statement: The KnowledgePlane MUST manage epistemic conflicts, stale doctrines, and invalidated claims through explicit contradiction journaling with impact-scoped containment (informational conflicts annotate CONTESTED without blocking unrelated work; operational/epistemic conflicts block dependent automation/promotion; constitutional conflicts fail closed on privileged operations).
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_16 mandates explicit impact-scoped contradiction containment rather than global fail-closed halts.
requirements.verification_strategy: Contradiction validator tests verifying claims marked CONTESTED block downstream automated promotion.

requirements.statement: Context retrieval MUST be decoupled from proprietary vendor APIs through stable capability interfaces (SemanticIndexProvider, GraphProjectionProvider, ContextCompiler); candidate providers such as OpenViking or Needle MUST undergo empirical benchmarking before adoption.
requirements.rationale: Preserves model and provider neutrality at context compilation boundaries.
requirements.verification_strategy: Context compiler mock tests and retrieval benchmark suite.

requirements.statement: KAD-PI MUST strictly enforce EXECUTION != LEARNING through an offline evidence-gated distillation pipeline that extracts repeated validated execution trajectories into deterministic tools, tests, linters, schemas, or compact local specialists.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_15 rejects online continuous memory mutation and mandates offline downward distillation.
requirements.verification_strategy: Distillation trajectory replay tests and observatory record validation.

requirements.statement: Security boundaries MUST enforce strict multi-domain isolation across AMDY Workstation, TELL Server, Local Sandbox, Remote APIs, and Knowledge Vault with zero ambient credential inheritance; raw secret access by agent prompts MUST be strictly forbidden.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_08 requires physical and logical credential isolation.
requirements.verification_strategy: Gitleaks scan, trivy audit, and capability-broker permission tests.

requirements.statement: The compute fabric MUST operate an asymmetric dual-node topology: AMDY Workstation handles interactive controller tasks, GUI presentation, and fast local steering; TELL Server handles headless batch execution, distillation pipelines, and multi-model benchmarking.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_11 and DEC_ID_23 leverages distinct physical hardware capabilities.
requirements.verification_strategy: Host capability adapter verification tests (tell-profile.test.mjs, compute-probe.test.mjs).

requirements.statement: KAD-PI MUST separate execution runtimes from work lifecycle authority using the KAD_WORKLOAD_V1 abstraction; OMP serves as primary interactive controller, Pi as portable worker runtime, and Warren as an optional evidence-gated detached offload provider.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_09 establishes tiered runtime substrate without coupling authority to any single execution harness.
requirements.verification_strategy: Workload provider adapter tests and role dispatch tests.

requirements.statement: Canonical work lifecycle authority MUST remain local to Git and workctl; GitHub MUST function strictly as a downstream collaboration, publication, and remote CI verification projection.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_12 preserves local sovereignty and prevents remote GitHub state from mutating local authority without explicit import.
requirements.verification_strategy: Git verification scripts and publication receipts confirming local-first authority.

requirements.statement: Financial governance MUST enforce pre-authorized economic envelopes with value-gated escalation; unauthorized metered spend is strictly FORBIDDEN, while authorized metered spend is PERMITTED within explicit budget caps when expected value, human attention leverage, or quality requirements justify it.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_07 establishes pre-authorized economic envelopes with value-gated escalation rather than a zero-spend mandate.
requirements.verification_strategy: Economic router tests (economic-router.test.mjs) verifying pre-authorized envelope and value-gating enforcement.

requirements.statement: Operational FinOps telemetry MUST optimize resources according to the strict priority: Human Attention > Epistemic Integrity > Maintainability > Money/Quota > Local Compute Cycles.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_20 establishes human attention and epistemic integrity as supreme scarce assets.
requirements.verification_strategy: Telemetry view model tests and observatory metrics checks.

requirements.statement: KAD-PI core engineering, research, knowledge, verification, and work package execution MUST be designed to operate completely offline; empirical validation of full autonomous offline survival remains EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED under EXP-KAD-OFFLINE-SURVIVAL-001.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_10 mandates core offline design while recognizing full empirical survival is experiment-gated.
requirements.verification_strategy: Simulated WAN fault-injection benchmark (EXP-KAD-OFFLINE-SURVIVAL-001).

requirements.statement: The 3-month operational destination MUST achieve a robust single-node Personal Engineering OS & Empirical Research Substrate with rock-solid workctl, full offline operation, and baseline telemetry.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_22 prioritizes near-term boring reliability and single-node stabilization.
requirements.verification_strategy: Milestone validation suite and 3-month goal verification receipts.

requirements.statement: The 6-month intermediate destination MUST achieve an operational Asymmetric Dual-Node Compute Fabric (AMDY + TELL) with governed asynchronous workload pipelines, downward distillation, and Warren canary offload.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_23 expands compute fabric across physical nodes based on empirical probe results.
requirements.verification_strategy: 6-month dual-node integration benchmark suite.

requirements.statement: The 12-month ultimate ideal state destination MUST achieve a mature, self-distilling Personal Engineering OS & Publishable Scientific Research Laboratory, producing high-quality publishable research artifacts and reproducible specifications.
requirements.rationale: Authoritative choice in DEC_ID_24 establishes the long-term vision of a mature self-distilling personal research OS.
requirements.verification_strategy: Annual governance audit and research artifact reproducibility verification.

gap_matrix.current_state: KAD-PI operates as a personal engineering repository with emerging research capabilities, but lacks formal single-operator identity boundaries in all subsystem contracts.
gap_matrix.target_state: Rigid personal engineering OS & research lab boundaries enforced across all tools and agent roles.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Subsystems occasionally scaffold multi-user or enterprise abstractions that must be pruned.

gap_matrix.current_state: Optimized for project lead AMDY with single-user filesystem and local Git bindings.
gap_matrix.target_state: Formalized 2-5 collaborator isolation with zero multi-tenancy overhead.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Collaborator export and replication packaging needs structured definition.

gap_matrix.current_state: Human executes workctl commands and responds to ask-me prompts, but some agent tools lack explicit human confirmation gates for sensitive actions.
gap_matrix.target_state: Adaptive cognitive engagement (CO-DESIGN, GATED, ASYNC, EXCEPTION_ONLY) with guaranteed human sovereignty over canonical knowledge, spend, and charter.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Automated policy enforcement of human approval gates on sensitive branches.

gap_matrix.current_state: Failure defined in principles but lacks automated telemetry detecting human cognitive fatigue or escaped complexity.
gap_matrix.target_state: Automated human intervention and cognitive overhead telemetry actively reporting friction.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Observatory tracks model tokens and compute, but does not yet quantify human intervention friction.

gap_matrix.current_state: STC lease mechanism exists in workctl but is partially advisory for subagent execution trees.
gap_matrix.target_state: Strict capability-enforced STC worktree sandboxes with deterministic boundary violation rejection.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Subagents can theoretically attempt out-of-scope edits if prompt steering fails; requires deterministic filesystem sandboxing.

gap_matrix.current_state: Librarian role and wiki linters guard vault, but promotion from research candidates to canonical notes requires manual human review.
gap_matrix.target_state: Automated multi-stage evidence gating pipeline verifying empirical receipts before queuing notes for human signature.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Formal transition state machine between research candidate and canonical vault doctrine.

gap_matrix.current_state: Economic router enforces zero paid API spend by default via local policy; metered calls fail closed.
gap_matrix.target_state: Pre-authorized economic envelopes with value-gated escalation; unauthorized spend forbidden, justified metered spend permitted within budget caps.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Economic router defaults to zero-spend policy; needs envelope configuration and value-gating integration.

gap_matrix.current_state: Environment variables used locally; gitleaks and trivy integrated into doctor suite.
gap_matrix.target_state: Formal capability-scoped credential broker with zero ambient prompt visibility and host-level isolation.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Credential broker abstraction needs implementation to prevent ambient token exposure in subagent shells.

gap_matrix.current_state: OMP operates as primary interactive controller; Pi exists as portable runner; Warren is planned canary.
gap_matrix.target_state: Full tiered execution substrate with evidence-gated asynchronous workload offload to Warren.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Warren offload provider requires empirical qualification under EXP-KAD-WARREN-ASYNC-002.

gap_matrix.current_state: Core tools run locally on Linux workstation; local LLM execution tested via Ollama/llama.cpp.
gap_matrix.target_state: Full core offline design (TARGET) with empirical qualification pending under EXP-KAD-OFFLINE-SURVIVAL-001.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Deterministic core is offline-capable; full multi-day survival under WAN disconnect requires empirical stress testing.

gap_matrix.current_state: AMDY workstation operational; TELL server profile defined (WP-018) and compute probe tested (WP-021).
gap_matrix.target_state: Persistent asynchronous batch workload offload to TELL over secure node transport.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Headless daemon and workload router across AMDY <-> TELL requires empirical qualification.

gap_matrix.current_state: Local Git is sovereign; GitHub remote synchronized as downstream projection with CI status check protection (WP-028A).
gap_matrix.target_state: Automated GitHub issue/PR import gateway preserving local workctl authority.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Automated bidirectional sync without granting GitHub authority to mutate local workctl state.

gap_matrix.current_state: Zotero local adapter (WP-005) and real-corpus research evaluation (WP-006) operational.
gap_matrix.target_state: Fully integrated R0-R4 claim-sensitive research workflow with automated citation graph triangulation.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Automated claim extraction and triangulation pipeline across local research corpus.

gap_matrix.current_state: Markdown Vault in vault/ is canonical; wiki lint and projection synchronization verified (WP-010, WP-011).
gap_matrix.target_state: KnowledgePlane sovereign authority with typed representations (Doctrine in Vault, Evidence in structured records, derived projections rebuildable).

gap_matrix.target_state: Offline trajectory pattern analyzer distilling repeated execution failures into deterministic linters and tools.
gap_matrix.gap_description: Automated distillation pipeline converting validated episodes into new regression fixtures and tools.

experiments.title: Full Offline Autonomous Engineering & Research Survival Fault-Injection Benchmark
experiments.hypothesis: KAD-PI can execute end-to-end multi-step engineering and research workpackages completely offline using local deterministic tools, local models, and the local Knowledge Vault with zero network degradation.
experiments.baseline: Online execution using frontier remote models and connected web search APIs.
experiments.candidate: 100% disconnected environment (WAN severed) using Ollama/Qwen local inference and local Zotero/Markdown corpus.
experiments.acceptance_threshold: 100% test pass on offline-capable workpackages; zero unauthorized outbound network attempts.

disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT: Offline operation validated as primary baseline with zero regressions.
disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT_NARROW: Adopt offline baseline for engineering/code, retain online fallback for broad literature search.
disposition_taxonomy.DEFER: Local model capability insufficient; defer until stronger local weights available.

experiments.title: Warren Detached Asynchronous Workload Provider Qualification
experiments.hypothesis: Offloading long-running, non-interactive batch tasks (distillation, fuzzing, multi-model evaluation) to Warren reduces human cognitive context switching without violating STC lease bounds.
experiments.baseline: Sequential foreground execution in interactive OMP sessions.
experiments.candidate: Asynchronous detached job submission to Warren worker with workctl status callbacks.
experiments.independent_variable: Execution runtime (OMP Foreground vs Warren Detached).
experiments.acceptance_threshold: Zero STC lease violations; >30% reduction in interactive session blocking time.

disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT: Warren promoted to standard WORKLOAD_PROVIDER for background batch queues.
disposition_taxonomy.MINE_IDEAS: Adopt detached job schema into lightweight local background runner; discard Warren runtime.
disposition_taxonomy.REMOVE: Warren introduces unmanageable complexity; reject dependency.

experiments.title: Beads Shadow Intent-Graph Projection Evaluation
experiments.hypothesis: Projecting workpackage dependency graphs and decision trees into Beads graph format provides actionable visual insight without competing with workctl lifecycle authority.
experiments.baseline: Standard workctl CLI status reports and Mermaid Markdown diagrams.
experiments.candidate: Beads graph projection generated as derived artifact in vault/90_Derived/Projections/.
experiments.independent_variable: Graph visualization format (CLI/Markdown vs Beads JSON).
confounders: Schema drift between workctl and Beads
experiments.acceptance_threshold: 100% deterministic compilation from workctl; zero mutation authority granted to Beads.

disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT_NARROW: Adopt Beads strictly as read-only derived visualization projection.
disposition_taxonomy.MINE_IDEAS: Port graph layout algorithms into native Sofia v3 Cytoscape explorer; discard Beads.
disposition_taxonomy.REMOVE: Zero measurable comprehension gain; reject projection.

experiments.title: OpenViking / Needle Semantic Knowledge Retrieval Benchmark
experiments.hypothesis: Local semantic embedding indices accelerate relevant context retrieval for complex architecture queries without hallucinating unverified connections.
experiments.baseline: Deterministic ripgrep, AST grep, and frontmatter property queries.
experiments.candidate: Local OpenViking/Needle vector index over canonical Vault Markdown.
experiments.independent_variable: Retrieval method (Deterministic Keyword vs Semantic Vector).
experiments.acceptance_threshold: Recall@5 > 85% with zero unverified document claims admitted into canonical context.

disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT: Integrate semantic index as rebuildable derived projection provider.
disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT_NARROW: Use semantic retrieval for exploratory search only; require deterministic paths for code/governance.
disposition_taxonomy.REMOVE: Excessive memory/latency overhead; rely on deterministic search.

experiments.title: TELL Persistent Headless Worker Integration & Evaluation
experiments.hypothesis: Offloading continuous test runs, multi-model evaluation sweeps, and distillation to TELL server keeps AMDY workstation responsive and accelerates iteration cycles.
experiments.baseline: Executing all verification and benchmarking locally on AMDY workstation.
experiments.candidate: Dispatching batch workloads to TELL server over SSH/secure transport.
experiments.independent_variable: Execution host (AMDY Local vs TELL Server).
experiments.acceptance_threshold: Zero test result divergence between AMDY and TELL; >50% reduction in AMDY workstation load during eval sweeps.

disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT: TELL established as canonical PERSISTENT_EXECUTION_NODE for batch workloads.
disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT_NARROW: Use TELL for nightly evaluations only; keep active test cycles on AMDY.
disposition_taxonomy.DEFER: Network/sync overhead exceeds benefits; defer dual-node operations.

experiments.title: Downward Distillation of Validated Execution Trajectories
experiments.hypothesis: Analyzing historical causal journals and test failures allows offline distillation into deterministic linters and specialist prompts that permanently eliminate repeated mistakes.
experiments.baseline: Ad-hoc prompt steering and manual debugging across successive workpackages.
experiments.candidate: Automated pattern extraction from causal journals producing deterministic checks and role contract fixtures.
experiments.independent_variable: Feedback mechanism (Manual Prompting vs Distilled Deterministic Checks).
experiments.acceptance_threshold: >40% reduction in repeated test-fix cycles on recurring task classes.

disposition_taxonomy.ADOPT: Formalize offline distillation engine as standard post-milestone workflow.
disposition_taxonomy.MINE_IDEAS: Extract manual distillation checklists for human review; discard automated generator.
disposition_taxonomy.DEFER: Insufficient execution history; defer until 50+ workpackage episodes recorded.
